body.heading: Dream big
paragraphs: Would your house be in a tree, under the sea, or on a cloud? Draw where it sits first.
Add the rooms you dream about: a library tower, a pancake kitchen, a nap room full of cushions.

body.heading: Add the details
paragraphs: Draw who lives there and how they get in. A ladder? A lift? A friendly whale who gives rides?
Show your house to your family and give them a tour, one room at a time.

takeaway: In a drawing, a house can have a slide for stairs and a roof made of cake.
safetyNotes: Dream houses can be as impossible as you like; that is the game.
screenFreeExtension: Draw a dream house for your pet, your teddy, or a friendly dragon.
